tables_1.title: Health Audit Checks Undertaken By WRSTG (MED) On A190

cells.value: Check functioning of manual drives of elevation and training mechanisms
Check functioning of loading system when using manual drive and in auto mode
Check the pressure and oil level of hydraulic system
Check complete functional checks of CA-190
Carry out Hydraulic system operations using hand pump
Check operation of locking and unlocking mechanism of tipping unit and rotating part
Check firing circuit from Post no.6
Check the actuation of feed system interlocks circuit of GM using БK-4 device

tables_1.title: Health Audit Checks Of A190 Undertaken By NAI (MBU)

cells.value: Check internal condition of barrel (Rust, pitting, carbon deposits especially at chamber)
Pass barrel bore wear plug bore gauge
Condition of barrel bore and chamber using video boroscope
Check for leakage in hydraulic buffer
Check level of working fluid in hydraulic buffer by reference to protrusion of the rod beyond the cover and face (size e, fig. 20.1) with the wedge open
Check visual condition of the breech block and its components. All components should be free from crack, burns, rust and dents
Check the protrusion of firing pin using gauge A.190.71.01.01
Check Cooling System of This Barrel (Pressure at 170 +/-20 bar)
Check protrusion of rod 23 of replenisher 22
Load three dummy rounds to check loading ramming smooth ejection and proper impression of firing pin (check from local/remote)
Carryout misfire drill using 02 in number dummy rounds (Authority: HQWNC / CGO Letter no. GN/0318 dated 02 Sep 20)
